question: Which of the following is a cattle fair celebrated in the state of Himachal Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nalwari Fair**__.

__
 
• **Nalwari Fair** is a cattle fair celebrated in the state of **Himachal Pradesh.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bilaspur town** **of Himachal witnesses the four-five day long Nalwari or Annual Cattle Fair each year in the month of **March or April.
 
• At this festival, people enjoy **wrestling** and several other** fun activities**. **Cattle** are brought from **Nalagarh** and neighboring areas of** Punjab, **for this celebration.
 
• The owners across the **country** bring their **beautifully decorated cattle **to the spot because the time is supposed to be of very lucrative deals for them. 
 
• **Fairs & Festivals in Himachal Pradesh are:**__
 __
 
• **Pori Festival.**
 
• **Minjar fair Chamba.**
 
• **Summer festival shimla.**
 
• **Halda festival.**
 
• **Sazo festival.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Doongri Festival:**__

 
 
• ​The **Doongri festival** is organized on the auspicious occasion of **Basant Panchami.** It is also popularly known as the **Hadimba Devi Fair.**
 
• The **festival lasts for three days**. It is organized at the **Hadimba Temple,** situated in the sacred **Dhungri Forest in Manali. **
